name: Cultist: Disdain removes Grasp of Zek'voz's cooldown and raises its mana cost by 25% (#1311)
contract: 707747 effect 0 is ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (aura 107), EffectMiscValue 11 = SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN, EffectBasePoints -6001 + DieSides 1 = -6000; effect 1 is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (aura 108), EffectMiscValue 14 = SPELLMOD_COST, EffectBasePoints 24 + DieSides 1 = +25%; both carry EffectSpellClassMask word0 bit1. Grasp of Zek'voz 573028 (SpellFamilyName 31, SpellFamilyFlags (2, 0, 0), exact bit1 match) has RecoveryTime 6000 ms and ManaCostPercentage 10. SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost (SpellInfo.cpp ~3077, what the spell_power_cost metric queries) applies SPELLMOD_COST to the computed mana cost, so a real +25% must show up there without any cast. -6000 ms exactly cancels the 6000 ms RecoveryTime once applied through Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns's native SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN handling, verified here first as a synthetic spell_modifier probe (no cast needed) and then as a real cooldown left on the character after an actual cast, which reset_cooldown and a second cast make comparable. 707747 is not in SpellInfo::IsAffectedBySpellMod's family-31 collision table, so the plain classmask match applies directly. Numbers read from Spell.dbc via coa-dbc-viewer. No script or SQL references 707747 or 573028. Regression guard for behaviour that already works natively.
